title: Washingwood site-data contract
description: The interface between the pipeline and the site. Each document kind is an entry point under $defs: league, trophyShelf, season.

league.title: League summary
league.description: Site-wide facts shown on Home and in navigation. Exported as league.json.

seasons.description: Every Season with a Season document, oldest first.

teamCount.description: Number of Franchises in the Season.

champion.description: The Champion of the most recent Season.

teamName.description: The Champion Franchise's team name that Season.

year.description: The Season the title was won.

trophyShelf.title: Trophy shelf
trophyShelf.description: Every Owner's career honours, shown on Home. Exported as trophy-shelf.json.

owners.description: One entry per Owner, former Owners included. Ordered by title count, then runner-up count (both descending), then name.

currentTeamName.description: Current team name: the team name of the Owner's most recent Franchise.

titles.description: Seasons the Owner was Champion, oldest first.

runnerUps.description: Seasons the Owner lost the championship Matchup, oldest first.

firstSeason.description: The Owner's first Season in the League.

lastSeason.description: The Owner's most recent Season in the League.

isFormer.description: True if the Owner has no Franchise in the most recent Season.

season.title: Season document
season.description: Everything the Season page shows for one Season. Exported as seasons/<year>.json.

teamCount.description: Number of Franchises in the Season.

dataTier.description: Data tier: how much detail survives for the Season. full = lineups, player stats, transactions; partial = league-level results, some detail missing.

label.description: Headline format, e.g. "PPR", "Half PPR", "Standard", "PPR + TE premium".

receptionPoints.description: Points per reception for non-TE positions.

tePremium.description: Extra points per reception for a TE, on top of receptionPoints. 0 when there is no TE premium.

keyValues.description: Headline scoring values to display, in display order.

label.description: What is scored, with its unit, e.g. "Passing TD" or "Rushing yard".

points.description: Points awarded for one unit (negative for penalties).

rosterSlots.description: Lineup slots, in display order. Slots with a count of 0 are omitted.

slot.description: Slot label: QB, RB, WR, TE, FLEX, D/ST, K, BE or IR.

count.description: How many of this slot a Franchise has.

podium.description: The Podium: Champion, runner-up and Third-place game winner, in that order.

lastPlace.description: Last place: the Franchise with the highest playoffSeed (worst regular-season standing). Not derived from final rank.

teamName.description: The Last place Franchise's team name that Season.

punishment.description: The Season's Punishment. Always null in v1; the site shows "Punishment details coming soon".

standings.description: Final standings, one entry per Franchise, ordered by rank.

rank.description: Final finish, 1 = Champion. Includes playoff and consolation results.

teamName.description: The Franchise's team name that Season.

pointsFor.description: Regular-season points scored, including manual score adjustments (matches ESPN).

pointsAgainst.description: Regular-season points scored against the Franchise.

playoffSeed.description: Regular-season rank 1..teamCount with ESPN tiebreakers applied. The highest seed is Last place.

rounds.description: Playoff rounds in order; the last is the championship, holding exactly one Matchup.

matchupPeriod.description: The Matchup period the round is played in.

weeks.description: The NFL Weeks the round spans. Two Weeks for a two-week round, whose scores are combined.

matchups.description: The round's Matchups, including first-round byes.

thirdPlaceGame.description: The Third-place game: the two semifinal losers. Its winner takes 3rd.

matchupPeriod.description: The Matchup period it is played in (the championship's period).

matchup.description: The Matchup itself. Never a bye.

weeklyResults.description: Every Matchup period in the Season, regular season and playoffs, in order.

weeks.description: The NFL Weeks the Matchup period spans.

matchups.description: Every Matchup in the period, consolation Matchups and byes included.

teamName.description: The Franchise's team name that Season.

punishment.description: A filled-in Punishment. Not produced in v1.

description.description: What the Owner had to do.

image.description: Site path of the picture, or null if there is none. Served behind the passphrase like everything else.

matchupPeriod.description: A Matchup period number, starting at 1.

weeks.description: NFL Week numbers, ascending, no repeats.

weeklySide.description: One Franchise's side of a Matchup in weekly results.

teamName.description: The Franchise's team name that Season.

score.description: Points scored over the Matchup period, without manual adjustments (as ESPN shows them). Null only on a bye.

bracketSide.description: One Franchise's side of a playoff bracket Matchup.

teamName.description: The Franchise's team name that Season.

score.description: Points scored over the round, combined across both Weeks of a two-week round. Null only on a bye.

matchupRules.description: Consistency rules shared by every Matchup. A bye has no away side, no winner and is not a tie. Otherwise both sides have a score; a tie has no winner; anything else names its winner.

home.description: The home side. On a bye, the Franchise on the bye.

away.description: The away side; null on a bye.

winner.description: Which side won: "home", "away", or null for a tie or bye.

isTie.description: True if both sides scored the same.

isBye.description: True if the home Franchise had no opponent.

bracketMatchup.description: One Matchup in the playoff bracket.

home.description: The home side (the higher seed). On a bye, the Franchise on the bye.

away.description: The away side; null on a bye.

winner.description: Which side advanced: "home" or "away". Null on a bye (the home Franchise advances without playing) or a tie.

isTie.description: True if both sides scored the same. ESPN breaks playoff ties, so the exporter should rarely set this.

yearList.description: A set of Season years, oldest first, no repeats.

ownerRef.description: A reference to an Owner: a stable slug plus display name. The same slug always carries the same name.

slug.description: Stable, URL-safe identifier for the Owner. Lowercase words joined by hyphens. Never an ESPN ID (ADR-0002).

year.description: A Season's year. Recorded history starts in 2018.

teamCount.description: Number of Franchises in a Season.
